handle_special_model: patch a transformer model forward method for special model types like deepseek_vl_v2 or qwen2_5_omni
update_module_moe: apply fused MoE module replacements to a model and optionally release the original module
check_mllm_model_batch: check and adjust batch size for multimodal LLMs to avoid tensor shape mismatches during quantization
get_predefined_ignore_layers: get the list of layers to ignore during quantization for a given model architecture
load_next_step_diffusion: load a NextStep diffusion model pipeline with tokenizer and model for image generation calibration
